identity.name: Domain Controller SMB Connection via DCSync
identity.summary: An attacker uses DCSync techniques to extract password hashes from a domain controller via SMB, triggering a suspicious SMB connection alert. Cortex should detect the unusual SMB activity from a domai
identity.description: An attacker uses DCSync techniques to extract password hashes from a domain controller via SMB, triggering a suspicious SMB connection alert. Cortex should detect the unusual SMB activity from a domain controller.

payload.code:
powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Import-Module ActiveDirectory; Get-ADDomainController -Filter * | ForEach-Object { Invoke-DomainSync -TargetDC $_.Name }"
net use \\dc01.contoso.local\IPC$
ls \\dc01.contoso.local\C$

expected_artifacts.description: SMB connection from domain controller to target

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious SMB Connection from Domain Controller
biocs.description: Detects an SMB connection initiated from a domain controller to a remote IP address
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip != '192.0.2.0/24'
| filter dst_port = 445
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'lsass.exe' or actor_process_image_name = 'net.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'dcdomaincontroller.exe'
